act.long_title: An Act to provide a general Penal Code for India.

section.heading: Deliberate and malicious acts intended to outrage religious feelings of any class by insulting its religion or religious beliefs
section.html: Whoever, with deliberate and malicious intention of outraging the religious feelings of any class of [citizens of India], [by words, either spoken or written, or by signs or by visible representations or otherwise] insults or attempts to insult the religion or the religious beliefs of that class, shall be punished with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to [three years], or with fine, or with both.]
